**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target).**

- **What exists:** § 15.1 gives IBM a real MSL defence/indemnity covering third-party IP infringement, breach of law and warranty failures, with a standard procedure at § 15.2 (prompt notice, cooperation, MSL control) and IBM-caused exclusions (IBM-selected marks; IBM written specifications/designs). No reverse IBM indemnity for MSL's services exists — Loan Agreement § 14 is confined to Loaned Items, and the Attachment 6 indemnities run in IBM's favour.
- **Why it still fails fallback:** (1) § 15.2(b) makes procure/non-infringing-substitute purely discretionary ("MSL may, at its sole discretion") with no refund if no cure is available; (2) § 15.3(b) caps "total liability for either Party, regardless of the form of action" at 3% of bill-of-materials value, which swallows the indemnity and is far below the 3× annual fees super-cap.
- **Cure:** two surgical replacements — mandatory cure remedies plus fee refund backstop, and an indemnity carve-out from the general cap set at 3× annual fees. Preferred-only items (affiliates, data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) were noted as short of preferred, not redlined.
